data.name: Mikayeel
data.gender_notes: Mikayeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God is He Who honors (makes exalted) and gives power
data.long_meaning: Mikail is the name of the angel Jibreel (Gabriel) in Arabic. The name Mikail means 'God is He Who honors (makes exalted) and gives power'. In Islamic tradition, Jibreel is the angel who delivers the revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Night Journey (Isra and Mi'raj). Mikail is also believed to be the guardian of the Throne of Allah, and is mentioned in the Quran as being present during the creation of Adam (AS)
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine support and protection, strength, and exaltedness
data.etymology: Mikayeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is He Who honors (makes exalted) and gives power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mikayeel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya, 'I'lam al-Muqriq Fi Sirr al-Asmaa wa-Sifat al-Arhaam', Chapter 10, Discusses Mikail (Mikayeel) as an angel of death, mentioned in hadiths.

Al-Qurtubi, 'Jamal al-Din Abul-Hasan Ali ibn Abdul-Karim al-Qurtubi, Al-Jami' li-ahkam al-Qur'an, Vol. 13, Discusses Mikail as an angel of death and mentions a hadith where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) talks about Mikail bringing the souls from the world.
